# branch create --fill selects a message source without requesting a commit.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-06T20:00:00Z'

mkdir repo
cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m Initial
gs repo init

git config spice.message.fill.command mock-message
git config spice.message.fill true
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RESPONSE=$WORK/message.txt
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=8

git rev-parse HEAD
cp stdout $WORK/before.txt
gs branch create uncommitted --fill --no-commit
git rev-parse HEAD
cmp stdout $WORK/before.txt

git config spice.branchCreate.commit false
gs branch create configured --fill
git rev-parse HEAD
cmp stdout $WORK/before.txt

# --commit enables filling, while an explicit message bypasses it.
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=
gs branch create generated --commit --fill
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^branch-create$'

env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=8
gs branch create supplied --fill -m 'Explicit branch message'
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^Explicit branch message$'

-- message.txt --
{{.Operation}}
